**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median listing price:** ≈ $850 000  
- **Median sale price:** ≈ $830 000  

These figures come from the most recent quarterly reports by major real‑estate data providers (Zillow, Redfin, and the California Association of Realtors). The median is used because it represents the middle value in the distribution of home prices, giving a more robust measure than the arithmetic mean, which can be skewed by a few very expensive properties.

> **Quick note:**  
> • The median price varies significantly by region—San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles typically exceed $1 million, while Central Valley and Inland Empire homes are often below $500 k.  
> • The median price has been rising steadily over the past decade, with a year‑over‑year increase of roughly 5–7 % in 2023–2024.  

If you need a more granular breakdown (by county, city, or price band), let me know!
